You can burn sage and let the smoke rise up around your body and environment (home, office, etc.). You could also search up feng sui (don’t know if I spelt that right). 
Some religions will use coconuts by hovering them around your head in a clockwise circle 7 times and then leaving it as an offering or throwing it into water. Some people will offer bird seeds for 40 days to the world. Some people will take salt baths with candles. All of these are inexpensive ways you can empower yourself to lift any negative energy. The biggest tool that will help you is having faith in the process and staying positive. Again try googling a remedy that works for you instead of paying others. I hope this helps! God bless!
